headlines.title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White
headlines.description: Arsenal defender Ben White says people don't know the "full story" behind his decision to previously make himself unavailable for England selection - but says he would make the same decision again.

headlines.title: Atletico target Zubimendi move - Tuesday's gossip
headlines.description: Arsenal midfielder Martin Zubimendi is a target for Atletico Madrid, Leeds United plan to step up contract talks with striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin, Barcelona are keen on Bayern Munich defender Jonathan Tah, plus more.

headlines.title: NI's O'Neill ruled out of Nations League matches
headlines.description: Arsenal forward Ceadach O'Neill is ruled out of Northern Ireland's final two Nations League fixtures against Ukraine in Belfast and Hungary in Budapest.
